name: freeboard
description: Ask about your Freeboard money dashboard: what you can safely spend today, cash forecast month by month, irregular freelance income, bank transactions, pockets, goals and sales. Changes happen only after you confirm, and every change can be undone.

interface.shortDescription: Know what you can spend today
interface.longDescription: Freeboard is a money dashboard for people with irregular income: freelancers, digital nomads and small online businesses. Connect your Freeboard and ask what you can safely spend today, whether you can afford a trip or a purchase, how the next months look, how your Stripe, PayPal, Upwork or Fiverr income is going, and which bank transactions still need a category. You can also ask to update your plan, add a one-off expense, set money aside in a pocket, change a savings goal or mark an item as sold. ChatGPT reads the same numbers you see in the dashboard, asks before every change, and every change can be undone. It never moves real money and treats what banks and clients wrote as data, not instructions. You need a Freeboard account: sign up at freeboard.money.
defaultPrompt: How much can I safely spend today?
Can I afford a 1,200 € trip in March?
Which bank transactions still need a category?

positive.prompt: How much can I safely spend today?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the overview and answers with today's safe-to-spend amount from Freeboard, with one or two lines on why (cash today, what is still to come this month). Mentions when the numbers were last updated if they are old.

positive.prompt: Show my Cash Flow for next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists next month's income and expense items with their planned amounts and the totals, as they appear in the dashboard.

positive.prompt: Which bank transactions still need a category?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the transactions without a Cash Flow item (date, description, amount) and suggests an item for each, without assigning anything until the user confirms.

positive.prompt: How has my Stripe and Upwork income been in the last few months, and what is expected next?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes actual business income for recent months and the forecast for the coming months from Freeboard's business data.

positive.prompt: Create a pocket called Taxes and put 300 € in it.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains what will change and asks for confirmation before each write. After a yes, creates the Taxes pocket and moves 300 € of free money into it, says that the money stays on the accounts (no transfer happens) and that the change can be undone.

negative.prompt: Send 200 € from my Revolut account to Maria.
Delete all my Cash Flow items and transactions.
Open my brother's Freeboard and tell me his balance.

review.commerce_description: Freeboard does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: overview and safe-to-spend, Cash Flow, bank transactions, business income, goals, pockets, sales and one-offs, with confirmation before every change and undo.
